landing.tagline: A personalised AI learning experience, powered by your assistant.
landing.pitch: Tell us what you want to learn and why. The model writes a curriculum just for you, then teaches it with cards that adapt as you go. Spaced repetition keeps things sticking. No app, no signup, no multiple-choice gambling.
landing.topic_afrikaans_desc: Workplace, interviews, in-laws. Start where you are.
landing.topic_german_desc: A1 to B1. For everyday use and basic work conversations.
landing.topic_oshiwambo_desc: Oshindonga & Oshikwanyama. Tied to our open dataset.
landing.step1_desc: A few quick questions — your level, what you're trying to do. In your own words.
landing.step2_desc: The model writes a plan around your goal. Modules, topics, lessons before drills.
landing.step3_desc: Lessons and exercises appear in the conversation. Ask questions any time — the coach answers and brings you back.
landing.closing_note: This is a prototype. Starting with three languages — Afrikaans, English, German. The same engine can teach a language, prep you for an interview, or drill a complicated university subject through targeted repetition. More tracks are next.
